messages.author: 821779a19716f7ae
messages.subject: F1 CP population
parts:
Hi there,

I am working on a cross pollinated population (100 sibling (F1) obtained from the cross of 2 heterozygous parents) and I'm doing some QTL analyses. I've worked with some softwares but I would like now to use R/qtl if possible.

My problem is that I have read conflicting things about R/qtl supporting or not this kind of population.


Can anyone tell me if this population could be used in R/qtl and if so, where can I get some information on how to use the data (read.cross format, commands to specify the population type..)? if not, any advice on the best other possibility?

Thanks a lot,

GD

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] F1 CP population
parts:
It is _possible_ to analyze such data in R/qtl, using the cross type "4way", but

- you need to first infer phase
- the encoding of genotypes is painful
- there's little documentation

karl

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] F1 CP population
parts:
If you have your data in joinmap/mapqtl format, you can try using read.cross with format="mapqtl".

The detailed codes (1-14) are listed in the help file for read.cross:

"For a 4-way cross, the mother and father are assumed to have genotypes AB and CD, respectively. The genotype data for the progeny is assumed to be phase-known, with the following coding scheme: NA = missing, 1 = AC, 2 = BC, 3 = AD, 4 = BD, 5 = A = AC or AD, 6 = B = BC or BD, 7 = C = AC or BC, 8 = D = AD or BD, 9 = AC or BD, 10 = AD or BC, 11 = not AC, 12 = not BC, 13 = not AD, 14 = not BD."

karl

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Re: F1 CP population
parts:
See, for example, this thread: https://groups.google.com/d/msg/rqtl-disc/hvnjBctL2dw/SGXmw6rP0WoJ

It's possible to work with such a cross in R/qtl, but you first need to determine phase/haplotypes, and R/qtl provides no facilities for that. And handling of this sort of cross is not documented.

You might want to look at other software solutions, such as QTLMap: https://forge-dga.jouy.inra.fr/projects/qtlmap

karl

The question is related to the Onemap program, I hope someone here may able to help me. 


I have two crosses with 350 F1 CP progenies each, since I genotyped these populations using GBS, the parental data is missing for some SNPs. My question is how to code those progenies to the Onemap format where the parental pattern is missing.

 

For example:

 

Case 1 (one parent is missing):

Female parent: AA | Male parent (missing): 00

Progenies: AA, TT, AT, TT ………

 

Case 2 (both the parents are missing):

Female parent(missing): 00 | Male parent (missing): 00

Progenies: GG, GA, AA………

 

How to code these progenies, since I don’t know parental patterns? I appreciate any sort of help.

 

 

Thanks

Ramesh

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Re: F1 CP population
parts: What you can do is to find a meaningful segregation ratio among progenies  and try to predict the parent cod according to Mendelian rules . for instance if you see 1:1 segregation like TT ,AA,TT, and one of the parent's code is TT then you can say the missing code in parent 2 is AT and so on...
